card.name: Coadministration and dose-change wording in interactions
card.fires_on: The last piece of 'coadministered' or 'concomitantly', or a word like 'increased' or 'dosage', in drug-interaction advice just before a caution or monitoring phrase.

modes.label: Coadminister ending
modes.description: The ending of 'coadministered' or 'concomitantly' right before 'with caution'.

modes.description: Words like 'increased' or 'dosage' in advice to change a dose.
